subtitle: Technical Club @ KMCE
aboutShort: Tech Tattva is the premier student-led technical club at KMCE dedicated to fostering innovation, hands-on learning, and technical mastery among students.
aboutFull: Tech Tattva is the official technical club of KMCE (Keshav Memorial College of Engineering). Founded with the vision to bridge academia and industry, the club empowers students to learn modern technologies, build impactful projects, and innovate through collaboration. We regularly organize technical workshops, hackathons, coding competitions, guest lectures, and peer learning sessions.

activities.title: Tech Events
activities.description: Engaging symposiums, tech talks, and tech showcases highlighting cutting-edge tools and frameworks.

activities.title: Workshops
activities.description: Hands-on coding sessions led by senior mentors and industry guest speakers.

activities.title: Hackathons
activities.description: Intensive innovation challenges where students collaborate to solve real-world problems.

activities.title: Competitions
activities.description: Algorithmic contests, web dev challenges, and design sprints to test technical skills.

activities.title: Learning
activities.description: Peer-to-peer study groups, project incubators, and structured learning tracks.

activities.title: Innovation
activities.description: Nurturing creative ideas and guiding projects from conceptualization to deployment.
